{{Top|leg|title=''Battle''-class ship}}
The '''''Battle''-class ship''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] design built by shipwrights affiliated with the [[Metatheran Cartel]].

{{Ship-stub}}

==History==
In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the Metatheran Cartel used the ''Battle''-class ship [[XP-38]] to destroy [[Velin Wir]]'s [[Metatheran Cartel jungle base|jungle base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. The Cartel then gave the ship to the people of Cularin as a gift, to try and improve the damage to public relations between the Cartel and Cularin that Wir had caused.
